Discoverer: Various security vendors including SentilOne, Cybereason, and CrowdStrike
Method of Attack: Supply chain attack via Trojanized installer and altered DLLs
Attack Vector: Trojanized installer (MSI) of the 3CX VOIP software
Indicators of Compromise: Trojanized installer signed with the company’s code signing certificate
Modified copies of ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll
Fetch and decode of Base64 data from ICO files in a dedicated GitHub repository
Infostealer functionality for gathering system information and browser data
